audience_id.description: Append to this Meta audience instead.

email.description: Email address. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

phone.description: Phone; include the country code or set default_country_code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

first_name.description: First name. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

last_name.description: Last name. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

city.description: City. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

state.description: State / province code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

zip.description: Postal code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

external_id.description: Your CRM id for this person. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

members.description: People to add. Hashed server-side; uploaded in batches of 10,000.

customer_file_source.description: Where the list came from (Meta-required). Default USER_PROVIDED_ONLY.
